seo.title: Workshops & Executive Training — Takao Umehara
seo.description: Innovation, creative thinking, and branding workshops led by Takao Umehara. Proven at Google, Microsoft, Tiffany & Co., Dentsu, and Havas.

kicker.jp: 思考メソッド・ファシリテーション

body.en: A systematic innovation methodology developed over 15 years to bypass obvious ideas and dismantle cognitive inertia. Used across tech giants, startups, and leadership teams to turn ambiguity into tangible momentum.
body.jp: 15 年以上の実践から体系化された、思考の慣性と機能的固着を打破するイノベーション・メソッド。Google、Microsoft、スタートアップ育成などで実践され、不確実な構想から手触りのある突破口を導き出します。

body.en: Break Bias applies structured cognitive operations directly to your real problems, moving beyond passive lectures to produce working prototypes and strategic clarity.
body.jp: 単なる座学ではなく、チームの実課題を持ち込んでその場で解法とプロトタイプを導き出すハンズオン形式です。

heading.jp: 新規事業・0→1 ベンチャー創出

body.en: Zero-to-one opportunity discovery from initial opportunity framing to rapid prototype testing. Dismantle industry default assumptions and validate core value hypotheses before spending capital.
body.jp: 0から1の事業機会フレーム、業界の暗黙の前提の破壊、プロトタイプを用いたコア仮説の高速検証。

cells.label: Use Case 02

heading.jp: プロダクト・イノベーションチーム

body.en: Hands-on immersion in the 8 systematic transformation tools. Escape incremental feature-creep, dismantle functional fixedness, and unblock stalled roadmaps with tangible breakthrough concepts.
body.jp: 漸進的な発想からの脱却、プロダクト要素の体系的変形、膠着したロードマップの突破。

body: Conducted at Microsoft, Google, Tiffany & Co.

heading.jp: クリエイティブ・課題解決

body.en: Analogical problem solving and cross-disciplinary constraints. Rooted in research from the book extra•ordinary and pedagogy at SVA NYC to create unexpected brand and experience breakthroughs.
body.jp: 類推発想（アナロジー）、異分野制約の活用、予想外の体験コンセプトやブランド体験の導出。

heading.jp: 経営・リーダーシップ層

body.en: High-stakes alignment sessions for executive cohorts. Surface unexamined organizational biases, clarify vision, and align leadership on core strategic bets with conviction.
body.jp: 経営陣の視線の一致、組織に沈殿した無意識のバイアスの可視化、戦略的確信の確立。

label.jp: BreakBiasの核となる8つの思考変形ツール

body.en: Unlike standard brainstorming where volume replaces rigor, BreakBias applies proven cognitive transformations directly to existing product components.
body.jp: 根拠のない自由連想ではなく、既存の要素に対して体系的な操作を加えることで確実な新解を導きます。

cells.heading: 01. Subtraction
body: Remove a seemingly indispensable element and force the system to perform without it.

cells.heading: 02. Division
body: Deconstruct a unified component physically or temporally and relocate its function.

cells.heading: 03. Multiplication
body: Duplicate an existing part while giving the copy a modified, non-identical responsibility.

cells.heading: 04. Task Unification
body: Assign a brand-new role to an existing component or to an ambient resource in the environment.

cells.heading: 05. Attribute Dependency
body: Link two previously independent variables so change in one dynamically alters the other.

cells.heading: 06. Inversion
body: Flip standard user flows, hierarchies, or business model assumptions completely upside down.

cells.heading: 07. Extreme Constraint
body: Drastically cut time, budget, interface size, or dependencies to trigger radical shortcuts.

cells.heading: 08. Intent Scaffolding
body: Decompose high-level human intent into precise agentic logic rules and automated workflows.

label.jp: 実施形式・スケジュール

body.en: Available in-person (NYC, Tokyo, or on-site worldwide) and in high-energy remote cohorts.
body.jp: ニューヨーク、東京、または貴社オフィスへの出張開催、オンラインリモート開催に対応しています。

cells.heading: Executive Sprint

body.en: Intensive immersion designed for leadership and cross-functional teams to align on a specific opportunity or unblock an immediate strategic barrier.
body.jp: 経営陣やリーダー層を対象に、特定課題の突破や新規施策の方向性合意を1日で一気に達成する集中セッション。

cells.heading: Innovation Lab & Build

cells.label: Multi-Week Cohort
cells.heading: Organizational Transformation

body.jp: ワークショップと定期メンタリングを組み合わせ、組織全体にイノベーションを自走させる企業変革プログラム。
